purpose: Source-to-wire field correspondence only. Not a second schema, wire codec, descriptor authority, registered candidate or runnable admission. The frozen #192 schema/spec remain authoritative.

kind.from: explicit workflow:/stage:/agent: raw record namespace; only that namespace is removed

name.from: explicit raw record key after its namespace; not config.name and not a node/position ID

config_json.from: INPUT/closure.json records plus INPUT/native.json complete literal rows/envelope, encoded with frozen #192 CAJ-1

raw_sha256.from: #192 raw-record domain over exactly kind/name/schema_version/origin/config_json; never fixture-file/self hash

workflow_json.from: EXPECTED/graph.json workflow, explicit child-path references replaced by those independently literal node objects, with recursively complete children; #192 CAJ-1

nodes.from: EXPECTED/graph.json rows in literal preorder; all 126 nodes, including 14 stages, 42 single_call and 70 script occurrences

path.from: literal EXPECTED/graph.json row.path array, never split from a dotted ID

node_json.from: entire row plus disjoint explicit node_envelope; recursively substitute its explicit child references, no default or policy inference

factory.from: null for literal stage; otherwise source-facts.json exact type/class_name and entire independent native/script effective config including inherited metadata

type.from: source-facts.json factories, keyed by explicit effective script/single_call type

class_name.from: full qualified class in source-facts.json factories

config_json.from: entire EXPECTED native or script config; #192 CAJ-1; no field filtering

position_id.from: EXPECTED/identities.json explicit position_id, e.g. r01_A1; not old r01/A1

variant_id.from: EXPECTED/identities.json explicit V01_clean; scenario alternatives mapped separately in EXPECTED/case-mapping.json

slot.from: EXPECTED/identities.json explicit slot, also equal to entire native map's slot

agent_config_json.from: unchanged independently literal old306 expected-positions.json matching explicit old_position; full envelope + native row; #192 CAJ-1

template_utf8.from: unchanged old306 expected-graph.json script_agents at the explicitly named old key

template_sha256.from: ordinary SHA256 of exact template UTF-8, not a domain digest; original three template hashes unchanged

variables_json.from: EXPECTED/identities.json root.script_variables complete literal object; #192 CAJ-1; no render or private source

engine_commit.from: actual declared candidate source tuple, not old306 source_basis, installed-source claim or inferred from current checkout

engine_tree.from: same actual candidate source tuple as engine_commit

field_sets.from: workflow = source-facts.json wire_field_sets.workflow (13 WorkflowConfig fields incl. _KNOWN_FIELDS); node = wire_field_sets.node (36 NodeConfig fields incl. _KNOWN_FIELDS); native = wire_field_sets.native, the 24 INNER single_call keys of SINGLE_CALL_SETTINGS as the PERMITTED set (subset check; required presence is engine validation; the six envelope keys are pinned by the entire factory config_json, never a flattened union; Temper rm-ae19e128); request = EXPECTED/request.json field_names [inputs, notify, workflow, workspace_path] from Temper's closed pre-commit T2 #198 declaration rm-31e24c00 (EXPECTED/request.json source pins). Sorted unique names. Declaration revisions remain explicitly distinct until the consumer binds an actual candidate source tuple; a changed inventory comes from the installed engine source at engine_commit, never from the descriptor.

candidate_identity.from: explicit synthetic fixture identity from EXPECTED/request.json descriptor_metadata; no candidate registration

logical_run_id.from: explicit synthetic fixture identity from EXPECTED/request.json descriptor_metadata

execution_uuid.from: explicit synthetic fixture UUID from EXPECTED/request.json descriptor_metadata; no real run allocation/collision check

workspace_path.from: explicit synthetic fixture path from EXPECTED/request.json descriptor_metadata; never opened

metadata_inputs_json.from: EXPECTED/request.json metadata_inputs, exactly the caller's options.inputs; no workflow input defaults applied (the 13 record_rNN inputs are left to workflow defaults); #192 CAJ-1

request_options_json.from: complete literal EXPECTED/request.json options: all four keys always present, notify null, workspace_path equal to descriptor workspace_path, admission excluded; checked separately against INPUT/request.json and the pinned closed T2 declaration; #192 CAJ-1

source.from: source mapping above, actual candidate declaration pins must be supplied without pretending this is installed/runtime attestation

records.from: all60 expectedRaw entries ordered by (kind,name), exact raw reference closure

graph.from: independent graph mapping above, not resolution of INPUT

positions.from: all42 explicit position rows in literal order

scripts.from: all70 explicit script occurrences in graph preorder, exact variables and byte hashes

unissued.explanation: No immutable/admission/readiness record or grant is synthesized. Unresolved source adoption and custody are not represented by invented values in required wire fields. A non-runnable fixture mapping is not permission to fill those fields. #192 must refuse a runnable attempt without actual authority/custody.

projection_rules._KNOWN_FIELDS: Only exact engine-owned frozenset[str] metadata, with full source-pinned membership, projects to a sorted unique string array. Workflow, node and inherited script-agent metadata all retain it. Runtime type checking is UNEXECUTED.
projection_rules.all_other_types: No cast, repr, set conversion, null/default substitution or dropped key. Native optional absence stays absent. Fixture table decoding never changes a literal value.
projection_rules.legacy_names: Legacy old_position and old_node_paths are explicit correspondence labels only; neither slash nor dot splitting is a wire ID conversion.
projection_rules.digests: Fixture file/decoded-map hashes are ordinary SHA256 evidence only. Wire digests must use #192's domain separation and CAJ-1. No codec is imported/run by this supplement.
